summary: Hyphanet is a peer-to-peer platform designed for anonymous file sharing, forum chatting, and hosting isolated web sites known as freesites. It routes traffic through a distributed datastore to conceal the identity of both publishers and consumers.
goodFor: It suits users who require censorship-resistant communication and decentralized publishing without relying on traditional server infrastructure.
watchOut: Development activity is slowing, and the distributed routing model can introduce latency and heavy disk I/O demands.
deployNotes: Because the application is written in Java, you will typically need to provision a suitable Java runtime environment and allocate persistent storage for the distributed datastore.
